name: TEF Entrepreneurship Programme
amount_note: US$5,000 non-refundable seed capital per selected participant, as stated on the programme page.
deadline: annual: portal opens 1 January, closes 1 March at midnight (per the programme page)
regions: Africa (all 54 countries per the foundation's homepage)
stages: business idea, or business no older than 5 years
eligibility: Africans aged 18 or over, with a business idea or a business no more than 5 years old. Applications go through the TEFConnect platform. Other criteria on the page; read it before applying.
notes: Window dates are the page's standing statement, not a 2027 announcement.

name: develoPPP Ventures
funder: German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), delivered by GIZ and partners
amount_note: Up to EUR 100,000 of catalytic funding per start-up (the page states 100,000 euros). Matching-funds model: investment of at least the same amount must be raised in addition.
deadline: current call: 15 November to 31 December 2026 (Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, Rwanda, South Africa, Tanzania)
regions: Nigeria, Egypt, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa, Tanzania (current call)
sectors: innovative business models with social and/or environmental impact (development relevance)
stages: early stage with initial revenues (proof of concept)
eligibility: Privately owned, profit-oriented start-up registered in the target country (or registering before the investment). Already generating initial revenues, high development relevance and scalability. Investors for the matching amount should be in advanced talks; matching funds received up to 6 months before applying can count.
notes: Not a pure grant: needs matching private capital.

name: Africa Business Heroes (ABH) Prize
funder: Jack Ma Foundation and Alibaba Philanthropy
amount_note: Ten finalists share USD 1.5 million in grant funding; the top winner receives up to USD 300,000 (homepage).
deadline: annual: the 2026 application deadline was 7 May 2026
stages: established: registered business or 3+ years of proven operation
eligibility: African entrepreneurs. The 2026 application required proof of legal registration or proof of operation for 3+ years (bank statements and similar). Read the current application guidelines each year.
notes: Funder names as shown on the prize site; confirm on the site's About page.

name: Africa Prize for Engineering Innovation
amount_note: 2027 prize: GBP 85,000 in total: GBP 50,000 overall winner, GBP 10,000 to each of three finalists, GBP 5,000 One-to-Watch (official news page).
deadline: annual: the 2027 prize call ran 13 July to 8 September 2026 (closed now)
stages: early commercialisation (eight-month commercialisation programme for the shortlisted)
eligibility: Engineers and innovators in sub-Saharan Africa. Two-stage application through the Academy's grants system. The how-to-apply page says applications are closed.
notes: Amounts from raeng.org.uk news item of 13 July 2026.

name: UNICEF Venture Fund
amount_note: Up to USD 100K equity-free for early-stage; up to USD 400K equity-free for growth-stage companies that graduated from the early-stage investment (page). Awarded in 2 to 3 tranches against an agreed work plan.
deadline: no deadline stated on the page; apply by Expression of Interest
regions: companies registered in a UNICEF programme country
sectors: open source frontier tech (the page lists Data Science and AI among tech areas)
stages: early stage; growth stage for graduates
eligibility: Private business, open source solution showing promising results, registered in a UNICEF programme country. Check the page for the country list.
notes: Whether Nigeria is on the programme-country list was not read from this page.

name: Echoing Green Fellowship
kind: fellowship stipend (grant; recoverable grant for for-profits)
amount_note: Seed funding: a stipend over 18 months (100,000 USD). For-profit organizations receive it as recoverable grants (fellowship page).
deadline: annual: applications for the 2026 Fellowship are closed
regions: not stated on the pages fetched
eligibility: Applicants 18+ (by 1 June in the 2026 round), proficient in English, early-stage organization or idea that needs financial and non-financial resources. A company valued over USD 5 million, or earning over USD 2 million revenue with net profit, is not eligible (2026 page).
